scope: Proposition 5.2 (Sharp codimension and prescribed-marginal entropy) of the manuscript “Entropy and Face Dimension of the Perfect-Matching Polytope” (preprints/Entropy-and-Face-Dimension-of-the-Perfect-Matching-Polytope-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 113 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c0b726a089502900), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer m ≥ 1, the graph Gm and the point x(m) above satisfy Fx(m) = conv{a(M1), a(M2), a(M3)}, d(x(m) ) = 2. The unique law on perfect matchings with mean x(m) is the uniform law on M1, M2, M3. Consequently, |E(Gm)| − d(x(m) ) = 3m − 2, H(x(m) ) = ln 3, F(x(m) ) = m ln 3, B(x(m) ) = 2m ln(3/2). (26)
